audit.why: Emerald+ 53.41% over 734 games, matches the table.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.mid instructs the player to "track Riposte's cooldown (roughly 14 seconds at early ranks)".
audit.why: Riposte is 24/22/20/18/16s. 14s is not the value at any rank, and it is 10 seconds short of the rank-1 figure. A player counting to 14 walks into a live parry every single time — this specific number turns the entry's core plan into a death sentence.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real span: 24s at rank 1, 16s at rank 5.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3] says Riposte "neutralises your entire combo window" but never states what parrying an immobilise actually does back to you.
audit.why: Riposte "stuns them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with this ability". Parrying your 3-stack Tongue Lash does not merely deny the stun — it converts her follow-up stab into a stun on Tahm Kench, who has no dash and no escape. That is the difference between a wasted cooldown and a lost fight.
audit.corrected: spikes[3] now states the parry-into-stun conversion explicitly.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry repeatedly sells a "Q-stun then Devour" chain as one combo.
audit.why: Riot's own text in the kit: An Acquired Taste — "At three stacks, he can use Devour on an enemy champion"; Tongue Lash — "If the champion already has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they are stunned and the stacks are consumed." The stun and the swallow draw on the same three stacks, so a Q cast at 3 stacks stuns and destroys the resource Devour requires. The real sequence is to let Q land the THIRD stack (which does not stun) and then press R.
audit.corrected: Rewritten as: build to three, let Q apply the third stack, Devour immediately; a Q thrown at an enemy already on 3 stacks stuns but burns the swallow.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry credits Tahm Kench with "Abyssal Voyage" 3 time(s) and treats it as a global/roaming ultimate.
audit.why: Abyssal Voyage was removed in the Tahm Kench rework. The kit file lists W = Abyssal Dive and R = Devour; there is no global travel ability in the kit at all. Advice built on "use Abyssal Voyage to roam / reposition cross-map" tells the player to press a button that does not exist.
audit.corrected: Every reference re-pointed to Devour (R) or Abyssal Dive (W) as appropriate, with the surrounding advice rewritten so it describes what those abilities actually do.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.late tells you to "peel your carry with W".
audit.why: W is Abyssal Dive, a knockup you land on top of enemies — it is not a peel tool for an ally. The ability that protects a carry is Devour (R), which shields the ally it eats. This is a leftover from the pre-rework slot layout.

HARD / 8.5-10 difficulty with Fiora owning levels 1-3 and the lane swinging on first item is consistent with the kit shapes and the 53.41% figure being a scaling-tank result rather than a lane-win result. No change.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are genuinely even — Fiora wants to keep procing vitals to maintain her lead but your Thick Skin sustain stabilises and she has no answer to your CC if Riposte is down. At 6 the lane begins tipping your way: Abyssal Voyage threatens global impact and removes her ability to freely all-in knowing you have no escape, because swallowing her off a bad engage now ends in death for her rather than a reset. The key mid-game discipline is patience: track Riposte's cooldown (roughly 14 seconds at early ranks), slow her once with Tongue Lash, let her burn Riposte on the first cast, then immediately stack to 3 and execute the stun-Devour on her next approach.

edits.before: Into the late game Tahm Kench becomes the problem she cannot solve — your Thick Skin at 2 items converts so much damage into grey health that Fiora's vital bursts are absorbed and healed back during brief disengage, and your Devour holding her out of a teamfight is often a fight-winning play regardless of whether you win the strict 1v1. The matchup inverts from what she expected in lane: she was ahead early but you outscale her in the context that matters, group teamfighting and objective control, where her duelist kit is limited and your stun-Devour disrupts the entire enemy team. Force 5v5s, peel your carry with W, and let An Acquired Taste stacks punish anyone who stands next to you in a prolonged fight.
